subject: Post-discovery: propose two demo windows + sample agenda
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@novapulse.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@novapulse.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: propose two demo windows + sample agenda

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick follow-up with two proposed 30-minute windows for the product intro (we'll cover product fit, deployment model, and a brief tech highlight):

- Option A: Wed May 21, 2025 — 10:00–10:30 PT (13:00–13:30 ET)
- Option B: Thu May 22, 2025 — 14:00–14:30 PT (17:00–17:30 ET)

Suggested attendees from your side: Product owner and an engineering/ML lead (so we can validate integration and data flows). From our side Ill bring a short pairing of product + solutions engineering (Karthik will cover the technical bits).

Attached: novapulse_discovery_notes.pdf (summary from today's call) and sample_demo_agenda.docx. Sample agenda (30 min):
1) 5m — quick intros & goals
2) 10m — product tour (high level & integration points)
3) 10m — technical deep-dive / questions (KV cache, latency expectations, data locality)
4) 5m — next steps & mutual action items

Can you confirm which option works best and who from your team you'll include? If neither slot fits, share 2 windows that do and we'll mirror. Once confirmed I'll send a calendar invite with conferencing details and a short pre-demo checklist.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: novapulse_discovery_notes.pdf, sample_demo_agenda.docx
From: Elena Park <elena.park@novapulse.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.g@novapulse.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-18T17:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose two demo windows + sample agenda

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the notes and the options. Both slots look feasible on our side, but wed prefer Option B (Thu May 22 at 14:00 PT). Confirmed attendees: myself (Product), Samir (CTO), and Tanya Li (ML Lead, tanya.li@novapulse.com). Tanya will want to dig into model-hosting constraints and data retention — would it be possible to reserve ~1015 minutes for a technical exchange? If the 30-minute cadence is tight, we could keep the meeting at 30 but ask Karthik to prioritize the most critical infra questions early.

Also: can you include a one-slide summary of the integration checklist in the invite (networking and auth points)? That would help us prep.

Once you send the invite Ill accept and loop in Tanya on calendar. Thanks.

—Elena
Elena Park
Product Lead, Novapulse
elena.park@novapulse.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@novapulse.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@novapulse.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-18T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose two demo windows + sample agenda

Elena / Samir —

Great — Thu May 22, 14:00 PT is locked on our side. Ive created the calendar invite and included Karthik and a short conferencing link (Zoom). Invite notes include the attached updated sample_demo_agenda.docx and a one-slide integration checklist as requested. Per Tanyas ask, well strongly prioritize the technical questions at minute ~15 so the ML/infra portion gets at least 10 minutes. If we need additional time after that, Karthik will stay on for a 10-minute overflow.

Pre-demo ask: could Tanya and Samir quickly fill out this 1-minute pre-call form so we can tune the demo to your infra constraints? https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1abc2-precall-questions

Next steps (mutual action items):
- Neha: send invite + attachments (done)
- Novapulse: confirm attendees on the calendar and Tanya to submit the pre-call form
- Karthik: prep a 3-slide tech appendix on deployment/quantization options

If anything changes Ill update the invite. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
